text: {"name":"mac_validate_rate_params","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Validates a packed rate entry against the current PHY mode and capability limits, reporting unsupported combinations through the firmware error path.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v2":"packed_rate_word","v10":"rate_width_code"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":10,"meaning":"Packed rate-parameter word in the 12-byte entry selected by the second argument."},{"offset":169,"meaning":"PHY or rate-mode selector that chooses the validation rules."},{"offset":177,"meaning":"Mode-dependent capability value used to select stricter validation for modes 2 and 3."},{"offset":179,"meaning":"Capability ceiling for the rate-width code."},{"offset":180,"meaning":"Rate capability limit checked against the requested rate parameters."},{"offset":181,"meaning":"Capability limit for the option encoded in bit 9 of the packed rate word."}]}
